events.title: Updated Project Sever Demo Now Available for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey Everyone,We’re excited to announce that Project Sever is participating in Steam Next Fest! Our Demo has received a major update with extensive quality-of-life improvements and new features to make your journey beneath the northern seas smoother and more enjoyable. Give the updated Demo a try and let us know what you think!As we continue working toward the full release, Project Sever is currently planned to launch in Q1 2027. events.title: Project Sever Demo is Live!
events.summary: Hey Everyone,We’re thrilled to announce that the Project Sever Demo is now available on Steam! After months of refining the experience, we’re finally ready to invite you aboard the submarine and take your first dive beneath the northern seas.This demo contains: The entire submarine is at your disposal (all the knobs, buttons, touch screens, instruments and other gadgets),First chapter of the game (around 2-2.5 hours to complete),Bonus content: Old demo level and time-trial challenge,Flat and VR

events.title: Playtest Closed! ⚓
events.summary: Hi, Captains.The Playtest for Project Sever officially closed on October 23 — thank you all for diving in and sharing your invaluable feedback with us! The official demo will launch on November 7, 2025. If Project Sever sent shivers down your spine, don't forget to recommend it to your friends—and join forces to explore the darkest corners of the deep, uncovering secrets buried for decades beneath the waves...And of course—add Project Sever to your wishlist so you won’t miss the descent.Stay ale

events.title: Project SEVER First Playtest is Live! 🚢
events.summary: Hey everyone! 👋The first Steam Playtest for Project SEVER is now live!Playtest Period: Sept 25 – Oct 23Estimated Playtime: ~2 hoursVR Mode SupportedYou can unlock access simply by clicking “Request Access” on our store page.Please note that the game is still in early development.If you encounter any issues during your playtest, feel free to share your feedback with us via email (support@indieark.com) or on our Discord.We’re excited to hear your thoughts—thank you for helping us improve the game!
